metadata.title: fix: use parameterized query to prevent SQL injection in cleanup_old_results
metadata.author: mango766

description:
The `cleanup_old_results` method in `ResultsStore` was using an f-string to embed the `days_old` parameter directly into a SQL query. While the parameter is type-hinted as `int`, Python doesn't enforce type hints at runtime, which could allow SQL injection if called from an untrusted source (e.g., an MCP tool call without type validation).

This PR replaces the f-string with a parameterized query using `?` placeholders, which properly escapes the input and prevents injection.

Closes #3898

commits.message:
fix: use parameterized query to prevent SQL injection in cleanup_old_results

Replace f-string SQL query with parameterized query using '?' placeholder
to prevent potential SQL injection when days_old parameter comes from
untrusted input.

Closes #3898

Signed-off-by: easonysliu <easonysliu@tencent.com>

commits.message:
security: Replace os.system() with shutil.rmtree() in run_mutmut.py

The os.system() call runs commands through the shell without proper
input validation, posing a security risk if command arguments could be
influenced by external input. Replaced with shutil.rmtree() for safer
directory removal.

Changes:
- Replace os.system("rm -rf mutants .mutmut-cache") with shutil.rmtree()
- Remove unused import os
- Add safe shutil import
- Document remaining shell=True usage in run_command (internal commands)
